title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00143 — wellbore not published in this release
source_system: Equinor Volve / public DDR release — Volve field Daily Drilling
excerpt:
00:00 - 02:00: POOH w/ 7" tubing from 2744 mmd to 2557 mmd. Avg pulling speed 6,5 jnts/hr.
02:00 - 03:00: POOH w/ 7" tubing from 2557 mmd to 2463 mmd. Avg pulling speed 8 jnts/hr.
03:00 - 04:00: POOH w/ 7" tubing from 2463 mmd to 2351 mmd. Avg pulling speed 10 jnts/hr.
04:00 - 05:00: POOH w/ 7" tubing from 2351 mmd to 2265 mmd. Avg pulling speed 6 jnts/hr.
05:00 - 05:15: POOH w/ 7" tubing from 2265 mmd to 2257 mmd. L/d DHSV assy
05:15 - 05:45: POOH w/ 7" tubing from 2257 mmd to 2186 mmd. Avg pulling speed 11 jnts/hr.
05:45 - 06:00: Counted joints on deck. Prepared to RIH with tubing on 5 1/2" DP
06:00 - 07:00: M/u swedge with pre-installed combination wiper.
07:00 - 07:15: Performed TBT for r/d casing equipment
07:15 - 08:00: R/d casing handling equipment. Removed control line spool.
08:00 - 08:15: Changed BX elevator inserts to 5 1/2" DP. Meanwhile cleaned and cleared drill floor.
08:15 - 08:30: P/u and m/u 5 1/2" stand, m/u to swedge. Changed to PS-21 slips and function tested same.
08:30 - 09:00: RIH closed ended w/ tubing on 5 1/2" DP from 2188 m to 2460 m. Avg. Tripping speed 530 m/hr.
09:00 - 09:15: Filled pipe
09:15 - 10:00: RIH closed ended w/ tubing on 5 1/2" DP from 2460 m to 2770 m. Avg. Tripping speed 530 m/hr.
10:00 - 10:15: Performed TBT for displacement observed losses on TT due to heavy fluid in annulus seeping past pre-installed wiper in tubing.
10:15 - 10:45: P/u and m/u pump-in sub. Installed lo-torque valve.
10:45 - 11:30: Lined up to rig pumps. Initiated circulation, staged up pumps to 3000 LPM 153 bar. Displaced well to SW.
11:30 - 12:45: P/u 1 m above combination wiper after 51 m3 of SW pumped. Continued displacing well to SW at 2200 LPM 58 bar, until OIW content below 30ppm. Pumped totally 151 m3 of SW.
12:45 - 13:00: Installed cement hose meanwhile performed TBT for cement job
13:00 - 14:45: Balanced cement plug in 9 5/8" CSG m 2569 m pumped 20 m3 wash pill, 2300 LPM/ 60 bar. Mixed and pumped 9,4 m3 of 1,90 SG cement slur
